bagPolicy.summary: Expect a metal detector and a thorough bag check at entry. Backpacks and excessively large bags aren't allowed.

parking.summary: Barboza has street parking only and no official parking partners.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Barboza. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks aren't allowed into shows.

accessibility.summary: Barboza is not wheelchair accessible. Limited seating in the back of the showroom is first come, first served, and ADA seating requests should be sent through the venue's form at least 48 hours ahead, Monday through Friday.

reEntry.summary: Barboza hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Online tickets come as AXS Mobile ID, Will Call or mail, and paper tickets with lower fees are sold at The Runaway during its daily hours. Bring a valid driver's license, state ID, passport, military ID or merchant marine ID. Underage fans aren't admitted to 21+ shows, and a temporary paper ID only works alongside your expired ID.

gates.summary: Barboza hasn't published entry and door details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
